description: This header file defines the AampMediaStream class which implements the IMediaStream interface for media streaming, including methods for loading media, setting rate, seeking, stopping, and registration of notifications. It integrates with GStreamer and the AAMP player, and manages event handling in a separate thread.

classes.name: AampMediaStream
classes.description: Implements a media stream interface integrating AAMP player with event handling and thread management.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads media content from a URL and optionally starts autoplay.

methods.name: SeekTo
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in seconds.

methods.name: InitConfig
methods.description: Initializes the media stream with a given configuration JSON.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event with a name and parameters.

methods.name: Worker
methods.description: Thread worker function executing background tasks.
